items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: and he had me, Rex Stewart, Coleman Hawkins, and guys like that.

ctx.x: Best brass I ever heard in my life, the loudest, strongest, and the band was blowing. They were playing, you know. And, who was in the band? But man, what a heck of a band! And Rex -- I'm pretty sure Rex was in there, Ham Davis, Rex Stewart, and who else? Because I mean when you -- you've got to stick your finger) your -- the main -- you could hear them ten blocks?
I mean that's the way the bands were playing and sounding in those days, you know.
